t: A veteran NXP chip that runs the classic mbed board and many 3D printers.
steps: Buy the Arm mbed LPC1768 board from NXP for about 56 US dollars.
Plug it into your computer with a micro USB cable.
Install the free VS Code editor and the PlatformIO add-on.
Create a new project for the mbed LPC1768 board.
Build the blink example and copy the file onto the board's USB drive.
Press the reset button and watch the onboard light flash.
Look at the community Mbed CE project for newer libraries and examples.
